value.rationale: The complete finite-field hyperplane boundary is canonical in Drinfeld period-domain geometry. The new higher-dimensional scheme-theoretic description determines every associated prime, its nonreduced transverse q-by-q rectangle, absence of embedded components, and uniform graded Betti shifts and degree. This is a natural complete classification of a singularity invariant rather than a single arbitrary coefficient slice or mere recomputation of a known table; its substantive object is N>=4, not the previously treated plane case.
